A.name: Padded paws
A.words: A low, soft thump, like a padded paw settling, with the faintest brush of fur. On wood: the same thump and a muffled hollow knock.

B.name: Leaf brush
B.words: The foot brushing through moss and leaves, a slow swish with a very light thump under it, no crunch. On wood: a real foot on boards, muffled.

C.name: Muffled forest
C.words: Today's real forest-floor footsteps with the crunch taken out: only their low, muffled part, slowed a little. On wood: real steps on boards, the same way. One leaf step keeps a faint low hum.

D.name: Paws and bare feet
D.words: Real recordings: an animal's paws on soft earth for leafy ground, and soft bare feet on wooden boards for planks. Their bright top is rolled off.
